title: Only 6% of Employees Turn to HR for Help. That's a Trust Problem, Not a Wellbeing Problem.
summary: Most organisations in Southeast Asia have answered the wellbeing question the same way: by buying something. An employee assistance programme. A mental health app. Wellness days. Then they look at the usage numbers and wonder what went wrong.
